records.sourceTitle: Wood et al., Lancet 2008, adjuvant vitespen versus observation in renal-cell carcinoma
records.summary: Primary endpoint is recurrence-free survival; the published intention-to-treat analysis did not show a statistically significant difference versus observation. Detailed eligibility and critical-bias review remain outstanding.
records.nextAction: Independently recheck original publication, reported population, censoring, effect size and confidence limits; do not generate a score from the abstract alone.

records.nextAction: Audit the C-100-21 to NCT00039000 linkage against original protocol and full publication before using any patient-level or metric data.
